categories.name: Perceivable
categories.description: Information and user interface components must be presentable to users in ways they can perceive

criteria.description: Provide text alternatives for any non-text content so it can be changed into other forms people need, such as large print, braille, speech, symbols or simpler language
criteria.mobile_specific: Consider screen size limitations when displaying alt text on mobile devices

criteria.description: Provide alternatives for time-based media (video, audio)
criteria.mobile_specific: Ensure media controls are touch-friendly and visible

criteria.description: Create content that can be presented in different ways without losing structure
criteria.mobile_specific: Support both portrait and landscape orientations

criteria.description: Ensure content can be zoomed without losing functionality
criteria.mobile_specific: Support pinch-to-zoom and respect system font size settings

categories.name: Operable
categories.description: User interface components and navigation must be operable

criteria.description: Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44 CSS pixels

criteria.mobile_specific: Include simple tap alternatives for complex gestures

criteria.description: Content should not be restricted to a single display orientation
criteria.mobile_specific: Support both portrait and landscape orientations unless essential

categories.name: Understandable
categories.description: Information and operation of user interface must be understandable

criteria.description: Make text content readable and understandable
criteria.mobile_specific: Consider mobile viewing conditions and screen sizes

criteria.description: Help users avoid and correct mistakes
criteria.mobile_specific: Use appropriate mobile input types (tel, email, etc.)

categories.name: Robust
categories.description: Content must be robust enough to be interpreted by a wide variety of user agents

criteria.description: Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies
criteria.mobile_specific: Test with mobile screen readers and assistive technologies
Handle device sensors and capabilities appropriately
